description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for synthesizing ELF files, including string tables, sections, segments, symbol tables, and notes, used for ELF file generation in testing or tooling.

classes.name: StringTable
classes.description: Class for managing ELF string tables, allowing addition of strings and avoiding duplicates.

classes.name: ELF
classes.description: Represents an entire ELF file, allowing addition of sections and segments, and finalization of the ELF structure.

classes.name: SymbolTable
classes.description: Builds symbol tables (.symtab or .dynsym) with symbol entries and associated string table.

classes.name: Notes
classes.description: Represents ELF note sections, allowing addition of notes.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a string to the string table and returns its label.

methods.name: AddSection
methods.description: Adds a section to the ELF file and returns its index.

methods.name: AddSegment
methods.description: Adds a segment containing specified sections.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes the ELF structure and prepares it for output.

methods.name: AddSymbol
methods.description: Adds a symbol to the symbol table with specified attributes.

methods.name: AddNote
methods.description: Adds a note to the notes section.
